headline: S&P Global Ratings Upgrades Uzbekistan to BB+
summary: S&P Global Ratings has upgraded Uzbekistan's sovereign credit rating to BB+, marking the first time the country has reached this level.
why: Sovereign credit upgrades lower borrowing costs for governments and state-owned enterprises, signaling improved fiscal stability and institutional strength to international investors.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: Credit rating upgrades generally improve investor sentiment and lower sovereign bond yields.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A sovereign credit rating upgrade is a standard market-moving event that typically leads to increased demand for the country's debt and currency.
